model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the dependency of trajectory length on $\gamma$ across three categories: Unsuccessful, All, and Successful. The x-axis is labeled "$\gamma$" and uses a linear scale with plotted values ranging from 0.85 to 1.00, featuring numeric tick labels at intervals of 0.02. The y-axis is labeled "Trajectory length" and employs a linear scale ranging from 10 to 22, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 2. The "Unsuccessful" category is represented by a red dashed line with circular markers and capped error bars. This line exhibits an upward trend across the x-axis, beginning at an initial value of approximately 16.9 at x = 0.85, rising to about 17.5 at x = 0.90 and 18.7 at x = 0.95, reaching roughly 19.1 at x = 0.99, and ending at a peak value of approximately 21.3 at x = 1.00. The "All" category is depicted by a blue dashed line with circular markers and error bars, which follows an increasing trend starting at roughly 15.3 at x = 0.85. The line gradually ascends to approximately 16.0 at x = 0.90, 16.9 at x = 0.95, and 17.1 at x = 0.99, culminating in a final value of approximately 19.2 at x = 1.00. The "Successful" category is shown as a green dashed line with circular markers and error bars. It begins at an initial value of roughly 10.6 at x = 0.85 and increases to approximately 12.6 at x = 0.90, followed by a more gradual rise to roughly 12.9 at x = 0.95 and 13.3 at x = 0.99, before ending with a sharper upward shift to a final value of approximately 15.3 at x = 1.00.
